headline: What to wear in a sauna
items: A cotton towel to sit on, always
Loose cotton or nothing at all
Leave synthetics outside — they trap heat against skin
No metal jewellery; it holds heat and burns
Remove contact lenses in dry heat

claim: Does a sauna help you lose weight?
finding: Not meaningfully. Weight dropped during a session is water, and it returns once you rehydrate. Regular use may support cardiovascular health, which is a different and better-supported claim.
source: Reviewed against published trials. We rate evidence strength on every health claim we publish.
